evidence: No J&K Police crime statistics publication located. Public figures surfaced only via press: crimes against women 3,405 in 2020 to 3,937 in 2021, and a reported 15.62% one-year rise.
how_to_obtain: PIO, Police Headquarters, J&K Police, Jammu/Srinagar (seasonal move of the civil secretariat affects correspondence — address both). Request the SCRB monthly station-wise cognizable crime returns, explicitly invoking s.7(9) RTI Act to require the data 'in the electronic form in which it is held' (CSV). Fee Rs 10; 30-day statutory reply; first appeal to the departmental First Appellate Authority; second appeal to the CENTRAL Information Commission (the J&K RTI Act 2009 was repealed post-reorganisation; the central RTI Act 2005 now applies).
notes: NEGATIVE FINDING, required by the brief. Genuinely security-sensitive jurisdiction — the RTI route here is materially weaker than elsewhere in scope.

name: Ladakh crime statistics — NOT PUBLISHED (negative finding)

MAP CAVEAT: tiny population denominators make per-capita rates statistically meaningless and will produce absurd choropleth extremes — suppress or band them
evidence: No Ladakh Police crime statistics publication of any kind was located. Only the citizen portal, a formations page and UT administration pages are indexed.
how_to_obtain: PIO, Police Headquarters UT Ladakh, Leh (see ladakh.gov.in/department/police-headquarters-ut-ladakh/). Request the SCRB monthly station-wise cognizable crime returns, explicitly invoking s.7(9) RTI Act to require the data 'in the electronic form in which it is held' (CSV). Fee Rs 10; 30-day statutory reply; first appeal to the departmental First Appellate Authority; second appeal to the CENTRAL Information Commission (central RTI Act 2005 applies).
notes: NEGATIVE FINDING, required by the brief. Mitigating: only 2 districts (Leh, Kargil) and very low crime volume, so a single well-drafted RTI could plausibly obtain the COMPLETE station-wise record for the UT. Use Ladakh to debug RTI wording cheaply before firing at larger states.
